method: Single-reviewer visual inspection of full-aspect 2000px local contact sheets, with original input/result images available in click-zoom report. Not blinded, no landmark/OCR quantitative measurement, no exact wearing ground truth. Strict verified pass requires all mandatory axes; broad-pose similarity alone is not a pass.
statuses: fail = visible mandatory discrepancy; not_established = no gross failure established but exact preservation/detail evidence incomplete; not_applicable = feature absent or source unreadable.
